tools.description: [Site data] Lists every body the Atlas carries: the Sun, planets, moons and asteroids, each with its id, kind, parent and radius.

tools.name: body_facts
tools.description: [Site data] Gives one body's size, mass, GM, surface gravity, rotation (pole: the IAU report's J2000 constants, before rates and periodic terms) and orbit, with the sources its registry row names.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: [Site data] Lists the surveyed sites on one body, each with its center, instrument and licence, by name or largest first.

tools.name: site_facts
tools.description: [Site data] Gives one surveyed site's terrain product, sample spacing, plots, relief, footprint and licence.

tools.name: list_layers

tools.name: describe_layer

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: atmosphere_profile, data_catalog · Private data: lunar_site_geometry, gravity_at, gravity_line, atmosphere_profile · Public sink: sample_points, region_stats · Destructive: lunar_site_geometry, gravity_at, gravity_line, atmosphere_profile, data_catalog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: atmosphere_profile, data_catalog · Private data: lunar_site_geometry, gravity_at, gravity_line, atmosphere_profile · Public sink: sample_points, region_stats · Destructive: lunar_site_geometry, gravity_at, gravity_line, atmosphere_profile, data_catalog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
